DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通教室の案内をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you seen the information about the traffic safety class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが小学校に入るので、横断歩道の渡り方を練習させたいです。教室では実際に歩きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 就学前の横断練習内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child is starting elementary school, so I want them to practise crossing at pedestrian crossings. Do they actually walk in the class?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about crossing practice before starting school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 室内の模擬横断歩道を使います。実際の道路へ出る練習ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We use a mock pedestrian crossing indoors. It is not practice on a real road.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 模擬の場所で練習できるのですね。子どもは六歳ですが対象になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 模擬練習を理解し六歳の対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So they can practise in a simulated setting. My child is six. Are they eligible?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the simulation and check eligibility for a six-year-old. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の教室は就学前のお子様が対象です。保護者も一緒に参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This class is for children who have not started school. A parent or guardian participates too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私も参加します。案内には十時開始とありますが、受付は何時からですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 親同行と受付開始時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take part too. The notice says it starts at ten. When does registration open?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the parent will attend and ask when registration opens. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 九時四十分からです。参加票は入口でお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: At nine forty. We will give you a participation form at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 九時四十分に来ます。上履きは必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付到着時刻と上履き要否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will come at nine forty. Do we need indoor shoes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your arrival time for registration and ask about indoor shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会場では上履きが必要です。親子分と、外靴を入れる袋をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Indoor shoes are required at the venue. Bring a pair for both of you and a bag for outdoor shoes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 親子の上履きと袋を用意します。六歳の子と一緒に、模擬横断の教室へ来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 親子上履き袋を用意し参加すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prepare indoor shoes for both of us and a bag. I will come with my six-year-old to the mock crossing class.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will bring indoor shoes for parent and child and a bag, and attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you. Thank you for your enquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書留での差出しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending this by registered mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この証明書を送ります。受け取ったか後で調べられる方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証明書の配達状況を調べられる発送を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am sending this certificate. I want a method that lets me check later whether it was received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a method for sending a certificate with delivery tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書留なら引受けの記録が残ります。こちらの料金と取扱いをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Registered mail leaves a record of acceptance. Please look at these charges and handling details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内容を確認しました。この方法でお願いします。控えには追跡番号が載りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書留を選び控えの追跡番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have checked the details. Please use this method. Will the receipt show a tracking number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose registered mail and ask about the tracking number on the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この番号で配達状況を確認できます。封筒の宛先を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can check delivery status with this number. Let me see the address on the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛先は提出先からもらった案内で書きました。この封筒です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内に基づく宛先の封筒を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrote the address using the instructions from the organisation receiving the certificate. This is the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the envelope addressed according to the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引受けが終わりました。こちらが控えです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Acceptance is complete. Here is your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号が見えました。控えをなくさないよう、写真を撮っておいてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受領番号を確認し控え写真保管を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see the number. May I take a photograph of the receipt so I do not lose the information?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the receipt number and ask about keeping a photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えの番号を読める状態で保管してください。原本も残しておくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep the number on the receipt legible. Keeping the original is also advisable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真を撮り、原本は提出用書類の袋へ入れました。番号で配達状況を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真と原本を保管し配達照会に使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I took a photograph and put the original in the bag for submission documents. I will check delivery with the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the photograph and original and use them for delivery tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりしました。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have accepted it. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自動振替のお申し込みですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to apply for automatic account payments, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 習い事の月謝を口座から払いたいです。来月分から引き落とせるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 習い事月謝の自動振替開始月を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to pay my class fees from my bank account. I want to check whether deductions can start with next month's fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the starting month for automatic payment of lesson fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 教室からの申込書をお持ちですか。開始時期の案内も拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the form from the class? Let me also see the information on when payments start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この用紙です。教室からは、最初の月だけ現金で払う場合もあると聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 教室用紙と初月現金の可能性を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the form. The class told me the first month might need to be paid in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the class form and explain the first month may be cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行の受付後、教室側の登録も必要です。この用紙には開始のお知らせを教室から出すとあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: After the bank accepts it, the class must register it too. This form says the class will notify you when deductions start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、今日出せば来月から確実という意味ではないのですね。開始の連絡は教室へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始確約でなく教室通知確認と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So handing it in today does not guarantee it will start next month. I will check the starting notification with the class.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand there is no guaranteed start and that you must check the class's notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。引落日も用紙でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please check the deduction date on the form too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毎月二十六日ですね。口座への入金を、前日までに済ませるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二十六日引落と前日入金の準備を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The twenty-sixth each month. I will make sure the money is in my account by the day before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the twenty-sixth deduction date and plan to deposit by the previous day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 口座番号とお名前の記入をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the account number and name you entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入は合っています。申込書を出し、来月の支払い方法は教室からの連絡で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座記入を確認し提出後の支払方法照会を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: They are correct. I will submit the form and confirm next month's payment method from the class's message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the account details and say you will confirm the payment method after submitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申込書をお預かりします。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the form. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 粉の商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a powdered product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲み物に使うココアです。量を毎回そろえたいので、計量スプーンの付いた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 計量スプーン付きココアを探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Cocoa for drinks. I want to use the same amount each time. Is there one with a measuring spoon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for cocoa with a measuring spoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの商品に小さいスプーンが付いています。袋の中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product has a small spoon. It is inside the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋の中なのですね。大きい缶より、棚に立てられるこの袋がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 付属位置と棚に立てられる袋の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inside the bag, then. Rather than a large tin, I prefer this bag that can stand on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm where the spoon is and request a bag that stands on a shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上にチャックが付いていて、開封後に閉じられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It has a zip at the top so you can close it after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ではこの袋にします。目安の量は裏の表示にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: チャック袋を選び一杯目安表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will choose this bag. Are the recommended quantities shown on the back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the zipped bag and ask about the serving quantity label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一杯分の目安と、お湯の量が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It shows the guide for one cup and the amount of hot water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一杯分の表示が読めました。牛乳で作る場合の表示もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 湯量と牛乳用表示を読んだと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read the one-cup instructions. There are instructions for making it with milk too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you have read the water quantity and instructions for milk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。付属スプーンは乾いた状態でお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please keep the included spoon dry when using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乾いたスプーンで量り、使ったら袋のチャックを閉めます。この一袋を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乾いたスプーンと閉袋を理解し購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will measure with a dry spoon and close the zip afterwards. I will buy this one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the dry spoon and closing the bag, and buy it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞレジへお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take it to the checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 噴水へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you going to the fountain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。車椅子のまま見られる場所を知りたいです。階段の上まで行く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車椅子で噴水を見る場所と階段要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want a place where I can view it in my wheelchair. Do I need to go to the top of the stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to view the fountain by wheelchair and whether stairs are necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 上の展望台は階段ですが、下の広場からも見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The upper viewing platform has stairs, but you can also see it from the lower square.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下の広場にします。水がかかりにくい位置はどの辺りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下広場を選び飛沫の少ない位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will choose the lower square. Where am I less likely to get splashed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the lower square and ask where there is less spray. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は右側から風が来ています。左のベンチの少し手前なら、飛沫から離れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today the wind comes from the right. A little before the bench on the left, you can keep away from the spray.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左のベンチの手前ですね。そばに車椅子で通れる幅がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左ベンチ手前の通行幅を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: A little before the left bench, then. Is the path there wide enough for a wheelchair?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the passage width before the bench on the left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 十分な幅があります。段差はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is enough width and no step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこから見ます。噴水が動く次の時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学位置を選び噴水開始時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will watch from there. Please tell me the next time the fountain starts too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose your viewing position and ask when the fountain starts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次は三時で、十分間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Next is at three, for ten minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三時から十分間ですね。下の広場の左側で待ち、そこから眺めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三時十分間と下広場左での見学を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ten minutes from three. I will wait on the left side of the lower square and watch from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm three o'clock for ten minutes and watching from the lower square's left side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ噴水をお楽しみください。ご来園ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the fountain. Thank you for visiting the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の使い方でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble using the ticket gate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗車券と特急券を持っています。ここでは一枚ずつ入れるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車券特急券の改札投入方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a basic fare ticket and a limited express ticket. Do I insert them one at a time here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to insert the basic fare and limited express tickets at the gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この改札には二枚を重ねて入れます。こちらの二枚を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this gate you insert the two stacked together. Please show me both tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二枚です。乗車する駅と列車の時刻は、どちらも今日の予定どおりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定日区間に一致する二券を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. Both the boarding station and train time match my plans for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show both tickets matching the planned day and journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この二枚で通れます。出てきた券は両方お取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can pass through with these two. Please take both when they come out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方取ります。出口でも同じように二枚を入れればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両券回収と出口投入方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take both. At the exit, should I insert the two together in the same way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm collecting both tickets and how to insert them at the exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出口では券の種類で扱いが異なることがあります。係員にも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: At the exit, handling can vary by ticket type. You can also check with a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口では表示も見ます。今はこの改札に二枚重ねて入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出口表示確認と現在の二券投入を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at the signs at the exit too. For now I will put these two stacked into this gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check exit signs and insert both tickets here now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。取り忘れのないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Go ahead. Please do not forget to collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚とも出てきて、受け取りました。切符入れにまとめてホームへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二券回収収納後にホームへ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both came out and I have collected them. I will put them together in my ticket holder and head to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Collect and put away both tickets, then go to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しくお住まいになった方への案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking for information for new residents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越してきたばかりです。図書館を使いたいので、利用の始め方が載った案内をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入後の図書館利用案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have just moved here. I want to use the library, so please give me a guide on how to get started.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for library usage information after moving into the area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図書館の案内があります。お子様の利用もご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have a library guide. Would you like information for children too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今回は私一人です。家から近い館の場所と、登録の持ち物を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人一人の近隣館と登録持参物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This time just for me. I want to know the nearest branch and what to bring for registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about a nearby branch and registration items for yourself alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この地図に各館があります。利用登録の書類は、図書館で現在の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This map shows each branch. Please check with the library for current registration document requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 地図では南の館が近そうです。この印の横にある駅から歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図の南館への徒歩アクセスを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The southern branch looks closest on the map. Can I walk from the station next to this mark?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check walking access to the southern branch on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅からの徒歩経路はこちらの裏面に載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The walking route from the station is on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏の道が見えました。駅から商店街を抜けるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏面の商店街経路を読んで確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see the route on the back. It goes through the shopping street from the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read and confirm the shopping street route on the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうです。休館日は各館の欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Check each branch's section for closed days.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南の館の欄と経路を持ち帰ります。持ち物は図書館へ問い合わせてから登録に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 館の欄と経路を持帰り登録持参物を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take home the southern branch's section and route. I will ask the library what to bring before going to register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take home the branch information and route and ask about registration items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご利用ください。ご来庁ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy using the library. Thank you for visiting our office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体温を測っていただけますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この体温計は音がしたら外してよいですか。耳が聞こえにくく、音が分からない時があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聴覚困難を伝え体温測定終了方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. May I remove this thermometer when it beeps? I have difficulty hearing and sometimes cannot hear the sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain hearing difficulty and ask how to know temperature measurement is finished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面にも終了の表示が出ます。私が近くで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The screen also shows when it is finished. I will check nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。脇へ挟む向きは、この先が上で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面確認の介助と挟む向きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. Is it correct to put it under my arm with this tip facing upward?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm assistance in checking the display and the direction for placing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先端を脇のくぼみに当てて、腕を閉じてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put the tip in the hollow of your armpit and close your arm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 腕を閉じました。測っている間はこのまま座って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 腕を閉じ座って測定すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have closed my arm. I will stay seated like this while it measures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have closed your arm and will measure while seated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 終了の表示が出ました。外して、画面をこちらへ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The completion display is on. Remove it and show me the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外しました。数字は三十六度八分と読めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終了後の数字を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have removed it. I can read thirty-six point eight degrees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the reading after completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私も確認しました。記録して、体温計を回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked too. I will record it and collect the thermometer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 数字を確認できました。音が分からなくても、表示と声掛けで測れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示声掛けで測定できたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I could confirm the number. Even without hearing the beep, the display and your spoken guidance let me take my temperature.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the display and spoken guidance enabled the measurement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 電話のことでご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about a phone call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行を名乗る人から、今日中に口座のお金を別の所へ移すよう言われました。まだ操作していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 移資金要求の電話と未操作を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone claiming to be from the bank told me to move my account's money somewhere else today. I have not done anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a call demanding money be moved and that you have not acted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お金を動かさず、その電話は切ってください。今も相手とつながっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not move money, and hang up that call. Are you still connected to them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう切りました。折り返し用の番号を言われましたが、かけていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通話終了と指定番号へ未発信を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have hung up. They gave a callback number, but I have not called it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the call ended and you have not called the given number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 教えられた番号を使わず、ご自身で確認した銀行の連絡先へ問い合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not use the number they gave. Contact the bank through details you checked yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通帳に載っている番号を使います。相手が言った名前と時刻はメモしてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通帳番号利用と通話メモ所持を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use the number in my bankbook. I wrote down the name they gave and the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will use the bankbook number and have notes about the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのメモを拝見します。口座番号や暗証番号を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me see those notes. Did you give your account number or PIN?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前は言いましたが、口座番号と暗証番号は伝えていません。送金もしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開示した名前と未開示口座情報と未送金を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I gave my name, but not my account number or PIN. I have not sent any money either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your name was disclosed, account details were not, and no money was sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状況を確認できました。今後同じ電話が来ても操作せず、ご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I understand the situation. If they call again, do not act; consult us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。メモを残し、銀行へは通帳の番号から問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモ保管と正規銀行番号への照会を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will keep the notes and contact the bank using the number in my bankbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to keep the notes and call the bank's official number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for consulting us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物をお送りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 陶器のカップを送ります。壊れやすい物の表示を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 陶器発送の取扱注意表示を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending ceramic cups. Could you put a fragile label on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a fragile label for shipping ceramics. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示は付けられますが、梱包も大切です。中で動かないように包んでありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can label it, but packaging is important too. Have you wrapped them so they do not move inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一個ずつ緩衝材で包み、箱のすき間も埋めました。今は閉じる前なので見てもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個別緩衝材と隙間詰めを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Each is wrapped in cushioning, and I filled the gaps in the box. I have not closed it yet, so you can look.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show individual cushioning and filled gaps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見える範囲では動きにくく詰めてあります。箱の底もテープで留めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: From what I can see, it is packed to limit movement. Please tape the bottom too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 底を留めました。上を閉じたら、表示は送り状と離して貼るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 底封緘後の表示貼付位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have taped the bottom. After closing the top, should the label go away from the shipping form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to put the label after sealing the bottom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送り状の文字を隠さない位置へ、こちらで貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will put it where it does not cover the writing on the shipping form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。箱を傾けずにここへ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を水平に置き貼付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will put the box here without tilting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put the box down level and ask for the label to be attached. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を貼りました。送り先をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The label is on. Please fill in the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送り先を書きました。カップの梱包と表示ができたので、この箱を発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送り先記入と梱包表示完了後に発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote the destination. The cups are packed and labelled, so I will send this box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill in the destination and send after packing and labelling are complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take it. Thank you for using our service.
